title: Among superheroes with missing weight data published by Marvel Comics, find
question: Among superheroes with missing weight data published by Marvel Comics, find those who are non-human and have the highest speed attribute value. Return their superhero name, race, and speed value.

prediction.sql:
SELECT s."XCL_019" AS superhero_name, r."XCL_017" AS race, ha."XCL_011" AS speed_value
FROM superhero AS s
JOIN publisher AS p ON s."XCL_026" = p."XCL_014"
JOIN race AS r ON s."XCL_025" = r."XCL_016"
JOIN hero_attribute AS ha ON s."XCL_018" = ha."XCL_009"
JOIN attribute AS a ON ha."XCL_010" = a."XCL_003"
WHERE p."XCL_015" = 'Marvel Comics'
  AND s."XCL_029" IS NULL
  AND r."XCL_017" <> 'Human'
  AND a."XCL_004" = 'Speed'
ORDER BY ha."XCL_011" DESC
LIMIT 1
